description: Implementation of Silero Voice Activity Detection (VAD) for Pipecat, including ONNX model wrapper and VAD analyzer classes.

classes.name: SileroOnnxModel
classes.description: ONNX runtime wrapper for the Silero VAD model, managing inference and input validation.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: VAD analyzer class using the Silero ONNX model, providing voice activity detection with support for 8kHz and 16kHz sample rates.

methods.name: SileroOnnxModel.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the ONNX runtime session with model path and execution provider options.

methods.name: SileroOnnxModel._validate_input
methods.description: Validates and preprocesses input audio data for model inference.

methods.name: SileroOnnxModel.reset_states
methods.description: Resets internal model states for inference.

methods.name: SileroOnnxModel.__call__
methods.description: Processes input audio through the ONNX model to produce voice activity detection output.

methods.name: SileroVADAnalyzer.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the VAD analyzer, loads the ONNX model, and sets up parameters.

methods.name: SileroVADAnalyzer.set_sample_rate
methods.description: Sets the sample rate for audio processing, supporting only 8000 or 16000 Hz.

methods.name: SileroVADAnalyzer.num_frames_required
methods.description: Returns the number of audio frames needed for VAD analysis based on sample rate.

methods.name: SileroVADAnalyzer.voice_confidence
methods.description: Calculates voice activity confidence score from an audio buffer, resetting model states periodically.
